listing.name: Trials HD — Trials HD Recompiled (snufflyyy)
listing.summary: The project claims controller and keyboard play. Browser storage, audio and gameplay checks remain unfinished. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Trials HD Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. XBLA title 5841095A; own default.xex and data.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run build.sh with your own Trials HD package and default.xex to generate code. The built game imports your own data on first start.

warnings: The project claims controller and keyboard play. Browser storage, audio and gameplay checks remain unfinished.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
